<a id="overview--首页摘要"></a>
## Overview

**Significance, comparison and practical judgment**

**Living significance: every living claim has significance from every standpoint; on a frame, realized living content falls under the relevance read from significance.** It gives significance, not a positive valence, and the readings of `living` do not include further generation; the direction of 生生 is read separately, by widening what can form (D1). The "positive" of this result's positive ground is the parameter of G0, not a valence that living significance supplies. Humans and AI are differentiated formations within that relational unfolding. With warranted generative correspondence and an explicit practical articulation, generative contributions supply reasons applicable to any agent so situated, independently of its culture, identity or endorsement. A single response can secure **some generative good in every supported visible continuation while leaving its particular future form open**. Real generative possibilities and further evidence revision can both remain available. This positive conclusion requires neither a complete future integral nor proof that the whole becomes strictly better.

**Evidence:** **Living significance is not an adopted axiom, nor a theorem proved outright:** the theory without axiom states it as a condition, and under the continuation condition it is a theorem (chapter section 6.4; the theory does not assert the condition); the chapter on its warrant sets out the support for its content. Lean checks what follows from it and, in one supplied law class, a dynamical distinction that an event-by-event broad reading does not draw; identifying that distinction with 生生 is a reading and correspondence question, not a Lean result. Premise footprint: the positive conclusion needs only living significance and actual correspondence, not whole improvement, a complete ranking or a future integral; one response secures some new generation in every visible branch without fixing its form, and new evidence can retract the certificate (independently reviewed). Every position with access has the reason whatever its endorsement, an independence supplied by the practical articulation rather than by living significance. Under a supplied no-recovery wear law (dynamics with no normative predicate): formation within renewal never ceases, whereas formation that persistently exceeds renewal, wearing the renewing organization it depends on, has a bounded total, ceases by an explicit time and ends co-dependent formation, although it forms more at first. A contributory reason is not by itself final permission.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Under explicit living significance and generative correspondence, one response realizing some new generation in every presently grounded continuation has some positive ground in each continuation, without fixing one new form across all of them. Explicit direct practical articulation supplies a contributory reason. The finite construction retains old joint possibilities, distinct real future branches and further evidence discrimination; a real burden or revisable admitted scope does not erase the positive result.

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- G0 is an explicit normative premise; actual new generative relations, the same response and the visible continuation scope require correspondence. The theorem uses no C, global no-loss premise or Better.
- Positive content supplies a contributory reason through an explicit direct practical articulation; it gives neither final permission, duty nor a uniquely optimal action.
- The optional finite integral uses local units, addition, duplicate-free occurrence domains and positive-contribution correspondence to actual generative relations; it is neither a sum of privately owned utilities nor a universal ethical total.
- The construction supplies explicit response, branching and reading laws. Actual coverage is used for scope-to-actual guarantee, without requiring identification of the whole universe or infinite future.

New content forms through prior activity, a productive relation and the common response in one unfolding. Each fixed productive model admits two real future branches; two surviving magnitude models separately represent epistemic uncertainty. Evidence filtering does not perform the response, so increased recognition is not new life. Existing formed perception, prediction and inquiry results ground visible futures interpretively; apart from the explicitly compiled truth-retention and scope-transfer examples, no new full same-history mechanism composition is asserted.
